geography level

datasets
- CANUE/healthyplan.city
  - dissemination block 
  - can only download one city OR one indicator
  - air pollution
  - tree canopy cover
  - avg. summer temperature
  - greenspace provision
  
- Census/statistics Canada
  - Geographic attribute file (dissemination block level)

- Canadian community health survey
  - health region (ON - intersection of HR and Ontario Health Regions)
  - can access via public use microdata
  
- CIHI
  - Health region (also facility, hospital peer group)
  - download indicator data
  
- Ontario geo hub
  - Ontario public health unit (smaller than region)
- Ontario community health profiles
  - ED visit rate/hospital admission rate/diabetes/chronic conditions/et.
  - 2020 Toronto neighborhoods
  - Create custom geography
  
- Esri Canada
- IntelliHealth Ontario
  - Only accessible to Ontario staff
- ICES
  - Special individual-level data
- iPHIS
  - Only authorized public health units
- Ontario health maps
  - Healthcare professionals and authorized personnel only

## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
